gitlens.ai.generateCommitMessage.customI: Follow Conventional Commits: write `type(scope): imperative description` with an optional scope. When the purpose or impact is not obvious, include a concise body explaining the rationale and summarizing the changes. Mark a breaking change with `!` after the type or scope and add a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer describing the incompatibility. Only report breaking changes supported by the provided changes; do not invent details.
gitlens.ai.generateCommits.customInstruc: Generate a coherent sequence of commits, with each message following Conventional Commits: `type(scope): imperative description`, with an optional scope. Split only at clear logical change boundaries. When a commit's purpose or impact is not obvious, include a concise body explaining the rationale and summarizing its changes. Mark any evidenced breaking change with `!` after the type or scope and add a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer describing the incompatibility. Do not invent details.
